docs.description: Full-viewport translucent overlay rendered behind Dialog, Drawer, and blocking modal surfaces. Uses color.surface.scrim token. Click dismisses the overlaid modal unless the modal is declared non-dismissible. Never use as a decorative background — scrim is a semantic focus-trap indicator that user attention is bound to the layer above it.

rules.reason: The translucent layer behind a Dialog, a Drawer and any blocking surface, as the description says: color.surface.scrim over the whole viewport, a click on it dismissing the surface above unless that one is not dismissible. MUI's Backdrop on the web, which the Dialog and the Drawer take as theirs; in Flutter a ModalBarrier of its colour, the barrier the dialog and drawer routes draw. Never decorative: it says the user's attention is bound to the layer above.
As its width, the viewport's height: Figma draws it 800 tall, a sample of a screen.
